meta.title: A knockout offer can be accepted by a vendor
gaps: Accepting a knockout offer specifically via a dedicated vendor-side step (knockout and dutch auction bidding actions have no automated vendor-side click step yet).
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Accepting a knockout offer specifically via a dedicated vendor-side step (knockout and dutch auction bidding actions have no automated vendor-side click step yet).

steps.note: Start creating an eRFX project to eventually convert to a knockout auction
Invite a vendor to the event
Publish the event to make it live
Convert the published RFQ to an auction (which enables knockout/dutch auction paths)
Switch to the supplier portal as the invited vendor
Open the auction event from the vendor's list

args.need: accept the knockout offer in the supplier portal and verify the round advances

steps.note: Vendor accepts the knockout offer since portal knockout actions require interactive vendor-side handling
